blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions

items.title: How can I save money on junk removal?
text: Sort your belongings first, remove items you can donate or recycle yourself, combine multiple items into one pickup, compare all-inclusive quotes, and choose a pricing model that fits the size of your load.

items.title: Is junk removal cheaper than renting a dumpster?
text: It depends on the project. Junk removal can be a better-value option for smaller cleanouts and bulky household items because the crew handles the lifting and hauling. A dumpster may make more sense for large renovation projects where debris is generated over several days.

items.title: Does junk removal charge by the hour?
text: Not always. Live Junk Free uses volume-based pricing in Toronto rather than charging by the hour.

items.title: Should I move my junk outside before the pickup?
text: Usually, you don’t need to. Full-service junk removal includes lifting and loading. Live Junk Free’s crews handle items from different areas of the property.

items.title: How do I get an accurate junk removal quote?
text: Provide a list or photos of the items and explain where they’re located. For Toronto customers, Live Junk Free provides a free on-site estimate before beginning the work.

items.title: Is it cheaper to donate items before junk removal?
text: It can reduce the amount of material that needs to be hauled away. If items are still usable, donating them can also give them another life instead of sending them for disposal.
